channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Iran: Strait to Remain Closed Until US Changes Behavior
item.description: The UAE's Abu Dhabi National Oil Company reported one of its ships was targeted while passing through the strait on Saturday.

item.title: Video shows Alabama deputies capturing a 1,500-pound runaway bull
item.description: The Pickens County Sheriff's Office reported that after some difficulty, the bull was safely returned without injury.

item.title: How social media apps can support children's mental health
item.description: ABC News' Stephanie Ramos discussed with Dr. Megan Moreno the implications of Meta's nearly billion-dollar penalty and its potential effects.

item.title: Why Trump's ballroom is considered a national security issue
item.description: Despite a court blocking his proposed $400 million ballroom, President Trump insists the project must proceed for reasons related to national security.
